visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman stand inside a brightly lit Apple Store. The man wears a black short-sleeved shirt and a beige tactical waist bag with various tools attached. The woman wears a black long-sleeved top and loose blue denim jeans. They are holding several white Apple Gift cards and an Apple logo paper bag. The man gestures with his hands while speaking, showing a small white card to the lens. The background features the signature minimalist aesthetic of the store with long wooden tables and glass partitions. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit modern office meeting room. A large screen displays a presentation titled 'CAMPFIRE BRAND MEETING' with a forest background. The woman from the previous scene is now seated at a long wooden table with several other team members who have their laptops open. She uses animated hand gestures, clapping her hands and pointing as she leads the discussion. (3) The woman begins distributing the Apple Gift cards to the team members around the table. One man in a black sweatshirt and glasses reacts with intense excitement, throwing both hands in the air and laughing broadly. Other team members are seen smiling and interacting. The environment is filled with typical office items like water bottles, notebooks, and digital devices.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the founders of the brand 'CAMPFIRE' purchasing Apple Gift cards worth 70,000 TWD and surprising their team members during a meeting as a reward for their upcoming participation in a camping event. It serves to showcase positive company culture and promote the brand's activities.
